A soft accent glow under the cursor on large library blocks (game page panels, What's New, collections).
A warm dark theme for Steam: Fluent structure, file-system-style panels and soft spots of light on a near-black background.

Blurs the wallet balance (or the account name and the balance) in the top-right account button until you hover over it; inside its menu the login and the balance are blurred until hovered — handy for streams and screenshots.
Compact: the menus, the tabs and the account buttons share one line.

How game covers in the library (Home shelves, collections) react to the cursor. 3D tilt: the cover turns toward the cursor in 3D with a moving glare. Lift: it rises a little. Zoom: the art zooms in its frame with a glare sweep.
How much a notification covers the desktop: lower is more transparent.

How much the theme moves on its own. Full: everything as designed (the default; already tuned to cost as little as it can). Balanced: fewer moving elements on and around items — no light following the cursor around store blocks and library panels, no shimmer on Play, no glares or light sweeps, 3D tilt covers lift instead, the Cinematic description stays still, the background light spots stand still; menus, hovers, page transitions, trailers, the store backgrounds (30 frames a second) and the glass notifications stay. Low: no Aika motion and no heavy effects at all — every look stays, but nothing the theme added moves (only Steam's own animations remain); the light spots are one still picture, no backdrop blur, no glass on notifications, no animated store backgrounds, no trailers playing behind the Cinematic page.
The "Add shelf" row at the bottom of the library home.
The "What's New" shelf at the top of the library home.
The Steam news (megaphone) button in the top bar.
The address capsule over store and community pages, top left (takes a Steam restart to reach the pages).
The font of the "Aika" wordmark in the background of notification toasts.

The layout of a game's store page. Cinematic: the trailers play muted over the whole window behind the logo, price and buttons, with a media gallery below; the editions and everything else stay as in Classic. Needs theme scripts.
The size of the cursor glow, in pixels.
The theme color set: the accent and the light spots. To set colors manually, turn on "Custom colors" in the "Color set" tab.
The wallet balance next to the account name in the top bar.
Use your own colors instead of the preset. The colors themselves (accent, accent hover, three light spots) are on the "Colors" page right below.
Where the Store, Library, Community and profile tabs sit in the top bar.
Show the optional ATOMS on/off comparison button. Turning this option off restores the theme and removes the button.

Balanced: fewer moving elements on and around items — no light following the cursor around store blocks and library panels, no shimmer on Play, no glares or light sweeps, 3D tilt covers lift instead, the Cinematic description stays still, the background light spots stand still; menus, hovers, page transitions, trailers, the store backgrounds (30 frames a second) and the glass notifications stay. Low: no Aika motion and no heavy effects at all — every look stays, but nothing the theme added moves (only Steam's own animations remain); the light spots are one still picture, no backdrop blur, no glass on notifications, no animated store backgrounds, no trailers playing behind the Cinematic page.

Balanced: fewer moving elements on and around items — no light following the cursor around store blocks and library panels, no shimmer on Play, no glares or light sweeps, 3D tilt covers lift instead, the Cinematic description stays still, the background light spots stand still; menus, hovers, page transitions, trailers, the store backgrounds (30 frames a second) and the glass notifications stay. Low: no Aika motion and no heavy effects at all — every look stays, but nothing the theme added moves (only Steam's own animations remain); the light spots are one still picture, no backdrop blur, no glass on notifications, no animated store backgrounds, no trailers playing behind the Cinematic page.
The "Add shelf" row at the bottom of the library home.
The "What's New" shelf at the top of the library home.
The Steam news (megaphone) button in the top bar.
The address capsule over store and community pages, top left (takes a Steam restart to reach the pages).
The font of the "Aika" wordmark in the background of notification toasts.

The layout of a game's store page. Cinematic: the trailers play muted over the whole window behind the logo, price and buttons, with a media gallery below; the editions and everything else stay as in Classic. Needs theme scripts.
The size of the cursor glow, in pixels.
The theme color set: the accent and the light spots. To set colors manually, turn on "Custom colors" in the "Color set" tab.
The wallet balance next to the account name in the top bar.
Use your own colors instead of the preset. The colors themselves (accent, accent hover, three light spots) are on the "Colors" page right below.
Where the Store, Library, Community and profile tabs sit in the top bar.
A soft accent glow under the cursor on large library blocks (game page panels, What's New, collections).
A warm dark theme for Steam: Fluent structure, file-system-style panels and soft spots of light on a near-black background.

Blurs the wallet balance (or the account name and the balance) in the top-right account button until you hover over it; inside its menu the login and the balance are blurred until hovered — handy for streams and screenshots.
Compact: the menus, the tabs and the account buttons share one line.

How game covers in the library (Home shelves, collections) react to the cursor. 3D tilt: the cover turns toward the cursor in 3D with a moving glare. Lift: it rises a little. Zoom: the art zooms in its frame with a glare sweep.
